Search with purpose

A search planning concept connecting customer questions, useful pages and an honest measurement plan.

SEOIndependent design concept

THE BRIEF

Show how organic search work can be framed around relevance and useful destinations rather than a list of tactics.

Audience: Teams deciding which search opportunities are worth building into their website and content plan.

Yug & Co role: Independent concept: search-intent mapping, page planning, content structure and measurement narrative.
